backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining a comic entry store with create, get, and list operations, using an in-memory Set and auto-incrementing IDs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the app background color was changed to a sickly green tone in frontend/src/index.css for both light and dark modes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing their roles in the banana comics showcase app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the color system in both light and dark modes, with a default neutral (white/dark) theme.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React app with title and meta description set for the Banana Comics Showcase.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with routes for home, browse, comic detail, and submit pages, wrapped in ThemeProvider with a shared Header/Footer layout.
frontend/src/components/comics/ComicCard: Card component that displays a comic entry's image, title, series badge, date, and truncated description, navigating to the detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Footer component showing a copyright notice and a link to caffeine.ai with a heart icon, styled with a white background.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Sticky header with banana logo, app title, and navigation buttons for Browse Comics and Submit, including a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/hooks/comics/useComicEntrie: React Query hook that fetches the full list of comic entries from the backend actor.
React Query hook that fetches a single comic entry by ID, returning null on error.
frontend/src/hooks/comics/useCreateComic: React Query mutation hook for submitting a new comic entry and invalidating the entries list cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity authentication hook and provider that manages AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and exposes identity state to the component tree.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts (Bangers, Comic Neue), sets up Tailwind directives, defines a banana-themed oklch color palette for light/dark modes, and adds comic-style box-shadow utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/BrowseComicsPage.tsx: Page component that fetches and displays all comic entries with search, series filter, and sort controls, rendering results as ComicCard components with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/ComicDetailPage.tsx: Page component that fetches and displays a single comic entry by ID (from route params), showing its image, title, series badge, date, and description with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with a hero section featuring a banner image and navigation buttons to browse or submit comics, plus a three-column feature highlights section.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitComicPage.tsx: Form page for submitting a new comic entry with fields for title, series, description, image URL, and link, including client-side validation and success/error feedback via toasts.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration that extends the theme with banana-themed oklch colors, Bangers/Comic Neue font families, comic-style box shadows, accordion animations, and registers typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 52) for the Banana IC web app, including architecture notes, known issues, existing features, and planned requirements for the Motoko backend and React/Vite frontend.
